findings.claim: Qwen27 NVIDIA precision was unconditionally labelled ModelOpt 0.48.0.
findings.evidence: Card says 0.48.0; config.json and hf_quant_config.json both record 0.47.0.dev80+g913f5e224 at revision 482ca0f3832238542f8f5295dde86b5f22711d80.
findings.resolution: Removed unconditional version label; preserved the disagreement in model.json, precision.md, README and sources.

findings.claim: FlashNext report baseline was TP4 while supplied NVIDIA vLLM baseline and producer example are TP8.
findings.evidence: NVIDIA pinned card target-only example sets tensor-parallel-size 8; supplied vLLM baseline profile sets TP8.
findings.resolution: model.baseline_tp now 8; README and serving baseline corrected; TP4 retained only as proposed capacity experiment.

findings.claim: FlashNext SGLang evidence was described as architecture-only and exact-export compatibility unresolved without acknowledging documented B300 recipe.
findings.evidence: SGLang PR #41046 merged 2026-09-24 into main; pinned recipe generator contains exact NVIDIA TP1 B300 cells with verified:false and v0.5.20 minimum. PR explicitly states no new GPU measurements.
findings.resolution: Documented exact-export TP1 candidate, retained unverified status; coordinated tooling update of supplied SGLang probe from TP4 to TP1 with documented flags and explicit local caps.
findings.status: owned reports corrected; profile integration delegated to tooling owner

findings.claim: Five of six checkpoint revision fields were unresolved; Flash official FP8 was only secondarily referenced.
findings.evidence: All six publisher-owned HF APIs returned immutable SHA; all six raw cards/configs downloaded with HTTP 200. Fifteen immutable source artifacts were fetched again and hashes matched.
findings.resolution: Pinned six variant revisions and base revisions, replaced owned mutable model citations, directly documented official Flash FP8 configuration.

findings.claim: 54GB was called a weight floor and 180B was insufficiently scoped.
findings.evidence: 27B and 125B + 51B + 4B are rounded publisher language-model figures. 54 GB is 27e9 × 2; 180B is rounded component sum, not tensor census or explicit vision count.
findings.resolution: Added decimalGB/GiB values, parameter_count_scope records and explicit formulas; preserved16GiBKV and144MiB matrix because their stated arithmetic is correct.

findings.claim: Normalized projection did not clearly distinguish config fields, derived quantities, publisher-card fields or one-based PLE index.
findings.evidence: 72 projected fields match inspected configs/card facts. Flash ple_layer_ids [2] maps to quantized tensor layers.1.ple; shared expert count and extended context come from card, rotary and attention counts are derived.
findings.resolution: Added projection provenance metadata, clarified architecture tables and precision labels.

findings.claim: Current SGLang Flash cookbook asserts thinking cannot be disabled and no generation recommendations exist.
findings.evidence: Pinned publisher card documents enable_thinking and both thinking/non-thinking sampling settings. Cookbook static NVIDIA hardware table also omits B300 additions in its own recipe generator.
findings.resolution: Recorded source disagreement; model behavior follows publisher card, deployment shape follows pinned generator; no benchmark claims copied.

findings.claim: NVIDIA export precision shorthand omitted exceptions and metadata label differences.
findings.evidence: 27B maps 401 module entries: 193 NVFP4 MLP/head, 208 FP8 attention; MTP ignored. Flash maps 48 NVFP4 expert entries, one FP8 PLE entry and one MTP entry with 128-wide blocks; the MTP label differs between config.json (FP8_PB_WO) and hf_quant_config.json (FP8_BLOCK_SCALES).
findings.resolution: Documented exact metadata scopes; avoided equating module-map entries with tensor bytes or measured execution.
